## 🛠️ Type of Change

Please mark the applicable option(s):

- [ ] 🐛 **Bug fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ **New feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 **Breaking change** (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 🎨 **Refactoring** (code structure improvement without changing behavior)

## 🧪 Quality Assurance Checklist

Before submitting this pull request, please ensure the following checks have been run locally:

- [ ] I have executed unit tests (`bun run test`) and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have executed Playwright E2E tests (`bun run test:e2e`) and verified user flows.
- [ ] I have performed TypeScript type checking (`bun run typecheck`) with 0 errors.
- [ ] I have checked ESLint rules (`bun run lint`) and code formatting (`bun run format:check`).
- [ ] I have updated tests to cover new or modified functionality.
- [ ] I have updated `CONTEXT.md` / domain documentation if architectural seams or aggregates changed.
